review: Evidence is limited to two completed primary trials. Trial 2 is clearly better than trial 1, and its route is exhausted. The proposed candidate is the closest untried extension of the strongest route, using the same frozen encoder and logistic classifier with nonlinear lexical features. No confirmation split or formal test is available.
hypothesis: A nonlinear RBF expansion of word/char lexical features combined with frozen MiniLM embeddings can model feature interactions that the linear word_char_minilm representation misses, potentially improving spam recall and macro_f1 on the primary split.
uncertainty: The nonlinear kernel may overfit or fail to improve over trial 2. Only primary search evidence exists, with no confirmation split or formal test, so direction and magnitude of any change are not predicted.
